observations.body: David prepares a place, says Levites must carry the ark, gathers priestly leaders, names the earlier failure, orders sanctification, and brings the ark with music and sacrifice while Michal despises him.
observations.label: The ark is carried by appointed Levites: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps David, Levites, priests, singers, musicians, Israel, and Michal, Jerusalem, the prepared tent, and the procession route, preparing, gathering, explaining failure, sanctifying, carrying, singing, sacrificing, dancing, and despising visible within David's story or later memory.

payload.posture: Read 1 Chronicles 15:1–29 as its own succession, retelling, and temple preparation David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places the second journey explicitly revises the mode of carrying while retaining public joy and household tension inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
